terms.meaning: A system that records delivery operations.
An inclusive range of days when a delivery is held.
An interval with its start and end values included.
A group of holds connected by overlap or gaps at most grace_days.
The later start day minus the earlier end day for holds without overlap.
A nonempty intersection of day ranges.
An identifier for an input hold.
Supply the function result to its caller.
A geographical area with a specified delivery policy.
